definition.def: A random sample or method is one in which all the people or things involved have an equal chance of being chosen.
examples: The survey used a random sample of two thousand people across England and Wales.
The competitors will be subject to random drug testing.

definition.def: If you describe events as random, you mean that they do not seem to follow a definite plan or pattern.
examples: Children's words and actions are often fairly random.

definition.def: If something happens at random, it happens without a definite plan or pattern.
examples: Three people were killed by shots fired at random from a minibus.

definition.def: If you choose people or things at random, you do not use any particular method, so they all have an equal chance of being chosen.
examples: We received several answers, and we picked one at random.
